messages:
Alex P.: hey all, starting today — quick onboarding Q. i got the sandbox key in my welcome email. how do i get a hosted/dev API key so i can run longer streaming experiments locally without the sandbox throttles?

Maya: welcome Alex :wave: Hosted keys are created in Console -> API Keys. Sandbox creds are the temporary ones in the email with free credits. If you don't see the button, your org role might be restricted. ping #eng-platform if that happens. Hosted keys are billable.

InfraBot: Note: creating hosted keys will generate an audit log entry.

Sam: for streaming tests, the common 429 reasons are concurrency limits or token-per-minute caps on the key. Try to reuse a single persistent stream for many requests instead of opening lots of short-lived streams. Add retry with exponential backoff + jitter on 429s.

Alex P.: thanks — is there a CLI I can script (linux) so I can add a key from CI or via my dev machine?

Maya: there is a small ops helper `rci-cli` (internal). example:
```
# create a hosted key named for your project
redwood keys create --type hosted --name "alex-autocomplete-dev"
```
it requires your SSO session. if the command fails with a 403, that's an perms problem — put a note in #eng-platform and they'll either create the key or fix roles.

Lisa: additional tip: when load-testing streaming, set a cap on concurrent streams and use client-side token accounting so you don't blast the token-per-minute quota. client jitter helps avoid synchronized retries.

Alex P.: can i get a temporary quota bump for a couple hours to do a throughput sweep? sandbox seems pretty tight for streaming.

Sam: sandbox is intentionally conservative. for realistic throughput, request a temporary dev grant (we usually do 24-72h windows). include project name, test window, peak qps or tokens, and billing owner.

Maya: format for the request in #eng-platform: project, owner, exact start/end time (UTC), estimated peak tokens/min and expected concurrency. e.g.:
- project: autocomplete-playground
- billing: @Jordan
- window: 2026-03-30T18:00Z -> 2026-03-30T20:00Z
- peak: 500k tokens over 2h
- concurrency: ~30 streams

eng-platform: noted the ping. we'll need the billing owner to ack and we'll review capacity. we aim to respond within one business day; temporary grants may have rate caps.

Alex P.: added @Jordan (billing). thanks everyone :heart:

Jordan: acked — i'll approve the billing side once eng-platform posts the quota details.

Maya: one last thing: when doing streaming experiments, prefer a single open websocket/stream and send multiple prompt messages down it rather than opening new socket per prompt. big reduction in handshake overhead and fewer 429s.

Sam: and instrument tokens-per-minute metrics in your client so you can throttle before the infra does. saves a lot of friction during tests.
